claims.claim: BBC reports Anthropic privately presented Q1/Q2/Q3 2026 revenue of $4.7bn/$11.6bn/$16.8bn, with Q3 up 45% sequentially; sequential growth slowed. These are not audited public filings, and Anthropic declined comment.
contradictions: No audited financial statements supplied; reported revenue growth does not establish durable margins.

claims.claim: BBC expects an Anthropic listing before year-end and attributes a second consecutive profitable quarter to other reporting; neither a firm November date nor an unadjusted profitability measure is established.
contradictions: Expected timing is not a confirmed listing date; the profit measure is not established as unadjusted.

claims.claim: Guardian reports Kospi 200 closing down 8.1%, SK Hynix nearly 11%, Samsung 9.5% and Nikkei 4.9% on October 15; BBC corroborates broad declines and temporary South Korean trading halts.
contradictions: Session moves are reported rather than independently retrieved exchange data; supplied Guardian text is truncated.

claims.claim: Guardian and BBC connect the sell-off with AI-spending concerns and unexpectedly high September US inflation; Guardian reports inflation at 3.7%. This attribution does not establish declining AI demand or infrastructure utilisation.
contradictions: Anthropic's reported revenue expansion is counterevidence to a simple demand-collapse interpretation; market causation remains interpretive.

claims.claim: Figma announces Specs combining Markdown, canvas references, diagrams, designs and code layers, with context passed to coding agents through its MCP server.
contradictions: Official search-returned article text was available, but subsequent direct opening failed; no hands-on validation or adherence measurement was performed.

claims.claim: Figma says Specs begins rolling out in open beta on October 15 to paid plans on web, desktop and mobile; rollout does not establish universal immediate access.
contradictions: Improved productivity and implementation fidelity remain unmeasured; shared instructions do not establish runtime enforcement.

claims.claim: Ai2's October 14 Hugging Face announcement describes HiRO-ACEv2 combining approximately 100 km ACE simulation with global 3 km HiRO outputs, adding wind and pressure to rainfall, and linking models, paper, tutorials and demo.
contradictions: First artifact availability and the original announcement's exact timestamp remain unresolved; architecture announcement is not independent scientific validation.

claims.claim: Ai2 claims global 3 km climate data at about 1/300th of X-SHiELD's cost and, with coarsened X-SHiELD inputs, target high-resolution statistics within 3% even for events occurring once per million data points.
contradictions: Cost comparability, independent reproduction and licensing were not checked; simulation fidelity is not demonstrated real-world forecast accuracy.

claims.claim: Ai2 reports residual hurricane-eye wind/pressure asymmetry and says HiRO currently requires ACE tuned to X-SHiELD, cannot yet produce other climates such as warmer futures or ERA5 historical data, and plans training on a world 4°C warmer.
contradictions: The 4°C extension is planned, not an available capability; operational weather forecasting is not demonstrated.

claims.claim: Figma's shared context object supports intent communication but does not by itself demonstrate permission enforcement, output correctness or customer-configurable runtime controls; the concept's workflow and form example are illustrative recommendations.
contradictions: No evaluated reliability gain or validated control mechanism is supplied; the recommended version-pinning workflow is not asserted as a confirmed Specs feature.

basis.de: Gleiche Basis: gemeldeter Umsatz je Quartal, nicht annualisierte Run-Rate. Laut BBC privat gegenüber Investoren präsentierte Zahlen; keine geprüften öffentlichen Abschlüsse und kein Margennachweis.
basis.en: Same basis: reported revenue per quarter, not annualised run rate. Figures privately presented to investors according to the BBC; not audited public accounts or evidence of margins.

checks: Rechecked the previous blocking issue: the Figma forecast now concerns future completion of staged rollout, not already-published MCP documentation. Both language versions explicitly identify the documentation as already available. The revised deadline and observable confirmation/falsification criteria are consistent.

Rechecked Anthropic figures against the supplied BBC passage: Q1/Q2/Q3 revenue of $4.7bn/$11.6bn/$16.8bn implies approximately 146.8% and 44.8% sequential growth. October 14 briefing timing, expected year-end listing and attributed profitability remain appropriately qualified.

Rechecked Guardian figures: Kospi 200 −8.1%, SK Hynix nearly −11%, Samsung −9.5%, Nikkei −4.9% and September inflation of 3.7%. BBC corroborates broad declines and Korean trading halts. Market explanations are not presented as measured demand or utilisation.

Reused the previous independent Figma and Ai2 checks for unchanged claims. Product availability, scientific results and limitations retain appropriate primary-source/vendor labeling; no independent productivity or real-world forecast validation is asserted.
Checked DE/EN equivalence, including the corrected forecasts. The concept distinguishes context, authority and verification and labels its workflow and example as illustrative recommendations.

Checked the sole visual's question, takeaway, values, quarter labels, units and provenance. Its comparisons use quarterly revenue consistently. No rendered chart or axis configuration was supplied, so rendered scale remains uninspected.
Checked novelty against the supplied prior edition and headlines; unresolved HiRO first-availability timing is disclosed rather than promoted into a newly available release claim.

Checked audit coverage against supplied records: 61 feeds, 57 successes and four failures match. Feed failures remain distinct from page-fetch outcomes; omitted_context counts omitted records. All 10 supplied continuity predictions, eight builder items and two theses are reviewed with historical statuses retained.

Reviewed the three forecasts for deadlines, observable criteria and inconclusive missing coverage. No material new defect was introduced by the correction. No new web retrieval was performed in this re-review.
